name: Hare Hare Harem
source:
"Several girls will love you at the same time and you wil be in trouble." Akihiro's fortunetelling goes like this... The fortunetelling is right and his life dramatically changes. Three girls suddenly say to him, "Please let me be your wife!" And Kotoko, his old friend, takes part in it and they start living together...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
“会有好几名女孩同时爱上你，让你陷入困境。”秋弘的占卜结果是这样……预言果然成真，他的人生发生了巨大变化。3名少女突然对他说：“请让我成为你的妻子！”旧友琴子也参与其中，众人开始了共同生活……

[摘自ErogeShop]
